description: This file defines a PromptSecurityGuardrail class, which integrates with Prompt Security API to sanitize and inspect files and message content for potential violations or malicious content. It includes methods for sanitizing files (images, documents), processing messages, and handling prompt security checks during API responses and streaming. It also contains a custom exception and configuration related to guardrails within a larger project.
